title: Online Misogyny Against Female Candidates in the 2022 Brazilian Elections: A Threat to Women's Political Representation?
benchmark_measurement: The vulnerability of female political candidates to misogynistic attacks based on their self-identified religious affiliation.
models_tested: Support Vector Machine with linear kernel (SVC_L)
findings: Candidates who identified as Evangelical received significantly more misogynistic mentions compared to candidates with Christian or Catholic religious orientations.
